title: sonar-migration-tool unified configuration
description: Unified config file shape consumed by every sonar-migration-tool command (extract, migrate, reset, predictive-report). Issue #266.

concurrency.description: Default max parallel HTTP calls. Overridden per command by source.concurrency / target.concurrency.

project_data_build_concurrency.description: Default max number of scanner reports built at once during project-data migration. Overridden by target.project_data_build_concurrency. Lower it if the migration runs out of memory on a large instance; raise it toward concurrency if report building is the bottleneck.

timeout.description: Default HTTP request timeout in seconds. Overridden per command by source.timeout / target.timeout.

export_directory.description: Root directory for extract / migrate output.

skip_issue_sync.description: When true (or on / yes / 1), skip the final per-issue and per-hotspot metadata sync after project data is replayed. Defaults to false so the sync happens. Issue #299.

skip_project_data_migration.description: When true (or on / yes / 1), skip the entire project-data migration: the project-data import AND the trailing issue + hotspot sync. Implies skip_issue_sync. Defaults to false so the data is migrated. Issue #303.

migrate_history.description: PoC (issue #554): when true (or on / yes / 1), also migrate a bounded set of historical analysis snapshots (date + project-level measures only) per project's main branch, backdated on SonarQube Cloud. Defaults to false — no change to existing behavior unless set.

history_max_points.description: PoC (issue #554): max historical snapshots migrated per project when migrate_history is set.

history_min_interval_days.description: PoC (issue #554): minimum spacing, in days, enforced between two migrated historical snapshots when migrate_history is set. The smallest effective value is 1 (one point per day at most); 0 is indistinguishable from 'not set' in a config file and falls back to the default of 30.

objects.description: Object categories to extract / migrate — extract and migrate only. Omit (or leave empty) to process every category, the default. When set without "projects", no project is created/extracted/migrated. Aliases: qp=quality_profiles, qg=quality_gates, pt=permission_templates, lp=license_profiles. license_profiles is accepted but not yet implemented (logs a warning and is otherwise ignored). Issue #536.

project_key.description: Regexp pattern of source project keys to extract / migrate — extract and migrate only; only applies when "projects" is selected via objects (or objects is unset). Implicitly anchored (^...$); a plain key with no regex metacharacters matches only itself. Issue #536.

source.description: SonarQube Server connection + extract-time options. Consumed by `extract` (and ignored by `migrate` / `reset`).

target.description: SonarQube Cloud connection + migrate/reset-time options. Consumed by `migrate` and `reset` (and ignored by `extract`).

extract_type.description: Extract scope. "all" extracts every available task; otherwise the name of a specific extract task.

concurrency.description: Override the top-level concurrency for extract calls.

timeout.description: Override the top-level timeout for extract HTTP calls.

pem_file_path.description: Path to a client-side certificate PEM file for mTLS to SonarQube Server.

key_file_path.description: Path to the private key matching pem_file_path.

cert_password.description: Password for the client certificate, if any.

target_task.description: Stop extract at a specific task (all its dependencies are still run).

extract_id.description: Reuse an existing extract directory ID instead of generating a new one.

enterprise_key.description: PROVISIONAL — ignored today; reserved for future SQC-to-SQC migration source side.

organization_key.description: PROVISIONAL — ignored today; reserved for future SQC-to-SQC migration source side.

edition.description: PROVISIONAL — ignored today; the SQS edition is read live from /api/navigation/global.

run_id.description: Ignored by extract (kept here for shape symmetry with target).

url.description: SonarQube Cloud base URL (e.g. https://sonarcloud.io/). Mandatory.

enterprise_key.description: SonarQube Cloud enterprise key used to scope create/list/delete enterprise endpoints.

edition.description: SonarQube Cloud edition used to gate edition-specific tasks.

concurrency.description: Override the top-level concurrency for migrate/reset calls.

project_data_build_concurrency.description: Override the top-level project_data_build_concurrency for migrate calls.

timeout.description: Override the top-level timeout for migrate/reset HTTP calls.

run_id.description: Resume an in-progress migrate run by ID. Null starts a fresh run.

target_task.description: Stop migrate at a specific task (all its dependencies are still run).

organization_key.description: PROVISIONAL — ignored today; reserved for future SQC-org-to-SQC-org migration target side.

default_organization.description: SonarQube Cloud organization key applied to every project when organizations.csv has no mapping defined. Ignored (with a WARN) when at least one row in organizations.csv carries a sonarcloud_org_key. CLI --default_organization overrides this. Issue #281.

project_key_pattern.description: Template for target SonarQube Cloud project keys, built from the placeholders <ORIGINAL_PROJECT_KEY> (mandatory) and <ORGANIZATION_KEY>. Defaults to <ORGANIZATION_KEY>_<ORIGINAL_PROJECT_KEY>. A single <ORIGINAL_PROJECT_KEY> with a static prefix requires a prefix of at least 5 characters; a bare <ORIGINAL_PROJECT_KEY> keeps the key unchanged. CLI --project_key_pattern overrides this. Issue #138.

migrate_history.description: PoC (issue #554): overrides the top-level migrate_history for migrate/reset. When true (or on / yes / 1), also migrate a bounded set of historical analysis snapshots (date + project-level measures only) per project's main branch, backdated on SonarQube Cloud. When absent, the top-level migrate_history applies (default false).
